item.title: Chadstone — History and How It's Changed
item.description:
Melbourne suburbs each carry their own history. The story of Chadstone is a story of cultural diversity.

See our full Chadstone suburb guide for the current picture.

What Chadstone Was Originally

Before it was what you see today, Chadstone was built around industry and working families. The original residents built the suburb’s foundation — the street grid, the housing stock, the community institutions that still exist in some form.

Like most of Melbourne, Chadstone’s history is inseparable from the broader story of a city that grew outward from the Yarra in waves. This suburb was settled when Melbourne needed it — whether for housing workers, accommodating families, or providing a retreat from the city centre.

item.title: Chadstone Neighbourhood Guide — Streets and Pockets
item.description:
Chadstone isn’t one monolithic block. Like most Melbourne suburbs, it has different pockets with different personalities. Here’s how to read the suburb from the inside.

See our full Chadstone suburb guide for the overview.

Chadstone Isn’t Just One Thing

Walk from one end of Chadstone to the other and you’ll notice the vibe shift. The main commercial strip has one energy. The residential streets behind it have another. And the edges of the suburb — where it bleeds into Malvern East — have their own thing going on.

item.title: Cost of Living in Chadstone Melbourne
item.description:
Living costs in Chadstone have shifted over the past year. Here is where things stand in 2026.

Read our full Chadstone suburb guide for the bigger picture.

Is Chadstone Expensive?

Chadstone is one of Melbourne’s more affordable options — especially considering what you get for your money. It won’t stay this cheap forever.

The cost of living here reflects what the suburb offers. Location, community, access to amenities — you get what you pay for, and in Chadstone, you’re generally getting good value for the price point.
